sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module enables students to enjoy the landscape of artificial intelligence and its applications in healthcare. In this module, students will acquire knowledge about the foundation of AI as well as a comprehensive view about applications of AI in healthcare. Students will have the opportunities to discuss and exchange ideas about the progress of AI in healthcare from many different perspectives during a designated series of research seminars.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Understand the general principles of artificial intelligence. B Be familiar with commonly used artificial intelligence models and tools. C Demonstrate an in-depth understanding about the potential applications of artificial intelligence in healthcare. D Deliver a well-reasoned and structured report about the current state and the future of AI applications in healthcare.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: This module is delivered through formal lectures and seminars.
